answer: A payout is split so that 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The relic schedule is applied in opal and shale shows each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1229 impostors cost 577 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
